name: v4.0.547
body:
## What's Changed

- [`@remotion/cli`: Add `remotion elements add-library` for adding Element Libraries to the config](https://remotion.dev/docs/cli/elements/add-library) by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13584
- `remotion`: Fix `useVideoConfig()` of a sequence with explicit `durationInFrames` being clamped by composition duration by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13605
- `remotion`: Keep emitted artifacts inside the output directory by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13532
- `@remotion/effects`: Keep WebGPU effects at 16-bit precision between passes by @dukeeagle in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13509
- `@remotion/media-utils`: Zero-pad `visualizeAudio()` FFT windows at the start of the audio by @Dani-Google in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13592
- `@remotion/studio`: Add settings search and inline descriptions by @Tatsuya0330 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13573
- `@remotion/studio`: Apply the selected double-click action immediately by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13580
- `@remotion/web-renderer`: Release capture canvases during export by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13574

## Skills

- Add `/remotion-elements` skill for installing Elements by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13583
- Install Basic Captions with `remotion elements use` by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13581
- Remove `/scaffold-element` skill by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13601
- Keep "Connect to Remotion Studio" step badges round by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13578

## Templates

- Set TypeScript `lib` to ES2022 by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13600

## Docs

- Add guides for [styling](https://remotion.dev/docs/captions/styling) and [editing](https://remotion.dev/docs/captions/editing) captions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13586
- [Move agent documentation to `/docs/agents`](https://remotion.dev/docs/agents) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13602
- Simplify the captions overview by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13599
- Fix off-by-one in remapSpeed() of the accelerated video snippet by @yunustopalogullari-sudo in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13593

## Internal and Experimental

- Share setup across related test cases by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13570

## New Contributors

- @yunustopalogullari-sudo made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13593

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.546...v4.0.547
